activity.notes: Ho-Chunk leader Hąboguwįga, also recorded as Ho-poe-kaw and translated Glory of the Morning. Jonathan Carver visited her village in 1766 and described her leadership. This is a directly attested activity point, not a one-year reign. Her full tenure and death year are not securely established; conflicting traditional accession dates and claims of survival to 1832 are not converted into a continuous reign.
